description:
Check what happened to a request, and read any questions it asked back.

    Intake is async (~5min cadence), so the status changes between calls.
    `next_action` is one of: "wait" (still processing), "answer_questions"
    (answer_request takes one answer per question), "done" (see
    generated_roadmap_item_ids), "cancelled" (terminal, no items), "failed"
    (see intake_failure_reason).
name: get_request_status
title: Get Request Status
